title: dynamo
description: Service discovery for PaperMC servers with NATS
body:
> **🌐 Dynamo – Smart Auto-Discovery & Load Balancing for Minecraft Networks**

Tired of editing `velocity.toml` every time you add a new server?
Want *true* failover and dynamic scaling without the hassle?

**Dynamo** is your new best friend.

⚡ **What it does**:
Dynamo lets your PaperMC servers register *automatically* with your Velocity proxy using **NATS** – no restarts, no manual config.
Servers come online → Dynamo detects them → players get routed *intelligently*. It’s that simple.

🧠 **Features**:

* **Auto-Discovery** – Zero config detection via heartbeat
* **Load Balancing** – Least players? Round robin? Your call.
* **Failover** – Server down? Traffic reroutes instantly.
* **Modular Design** – Lightweight, blazing fast, no bloat

🚀 **Perfect for**:

* Mini-game networks with dynamic server pools
* Scalable survival hubs
* Dev teams tired of copy-pasting IPs

📦 Includes:

* Velocity plugin
* PaperMC plugin
* Easy-to-use Gradle build system
* Full open-source code

🛠️ **Requirements**:

* A running [NATS server](https://nats.io/)
* Velocity proxy
* PaperMC servers (1.19+ recommended)

🔗 **Get started in minutes** – full setup guide on GitHub.

---

> **No more static configs. Just plug, play, and scale.**
> **➜ Try Dynamo now and power up your Minecraft infrastructure.**
